question: In a certain code, OQIOIQOQQIOQ is written as OIQOQQIOQOQI. How will EFKFKEKEFFEK be written as in that code?
solution:
**Explanation:**

The pattern followed here is:

OQIOIQOQQIOQ is written as OIQOQQIOQOQI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/477ed3ce8df7365bfc665609d42dcce2f617a7b5ba1ceeb58e07723d341000fc.png] 

Similarly, EFKFKEKEFFEK will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e51feecdb4577fccbf291f5833cf019782623e2e75e11446865d775234365587.png] 

**Hence, 'option 3' is the correct answer.**
